subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Medusa Complex
description: A quick win: understand The Medusa Complex.

hook.text: Medusa turned men to stone with her gaze. Freud saw her as a symbol of castration anxiety.

buildup.text: In myth, Medusa was once beautiful. Athena cursed her, turning her hair into snakes.

discovery.text: Freud interpreted the snakes as phallic symbols. The petrification was frozen terror.

twist.text: Feminist scholars flipped the reading. Medusa represents female power that terrifies men.

climax.text: Same myth, opposite readings: male fear or female power. The symbol contains both.

quiz.question: How did Freud interpret Medusa's snakes?
options: As phallic symbols tied to anxiety
